include_directories(..)

# ramdisk.c replaced by Rust (ramdisk-rust). Pure WDM RAM-disk class driver -- no miniport /
# no ISR / no DPC / no HW register I/O. ramdisk.c kept on disk (never-delete). Bar: link-clean x3.

add_driver_inf(ramdisk ramdisk.inf)

# ramdisk.sys is all Rust (ramdisk-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/ramdisk-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(ramdisk_res OBJECT ramdisk.rc)
target_include_directories(ramdisk_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(ramdisk ramdisk-cargo ramdisk.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE ramdisk-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS ramdisk_res psdk)
